popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Staphylus sails with Jason among the Argonauts — Dionysus' Lemnian son named for the grape-cluster, joining the fleece voyage from Ariadne's island line.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus lists Staphylus among the sons Dionysus begot on Ariadne — brother of Oenopion and Thoas, the grape-name in the Lemnian dynasty.

popCulture.title: Staphylus (son of Dionysus)
popCulture.description: Son of Dionysus and Ariadne — Argonaut and eponym of the grape-cluster (staphyle), not the butterfly genus that borrowed his name.
